scope.new_exposure_note: The three-object group was a test group in the original split. Any collected teacher training exposes it; its prior development results are not held out after use.
scope.coordinate_and_seed_provenance: Four coordinates and the 24-seed pool come from the prior public teacher 192 plan; the deterministic scene/coordinate/seed combinations below are preassigned, not certified historically unused.

schedule_rule: First-move direction lexicographic, count 3 then 4, ten starts each. Cycle source tower replicates 1,2,3,4; keep four-object scenes or remove the other singleton for three objects. First five target move 1, last five target move 2; target_direction gives the actual selected transfer direction and is itself balanced across the 12 directions. Assign a deterministic source-pool seed while rejecting any duplicate planned or source teacher-192/48 scene-coordinate-seed tuple; never redraw after observing a result.

protocol.stall_signal: after CLOSE, first three consecutive confirmed MOVE applied-target changes at most 0.25 degrees; save the next-decision state only
protocol.stall_selection: Only after actual no-OPEN decision-limit termination and uninterrupted small-MOVE tail through decision 60; select the first qualifying boundary of that tail.
protocol.normal_selection: Corresponding same direction and count: save before the student's first applied OPEN; a saved point alone is not physical success.

exclusions.design_tuple_uniqueness: 240 distinct proposed seed, coordinate and initial-scene tuples; not a physical-state fingerprint
exclusions.required_actual_check: Before any teacher data is collected, compare the new full initial-state digest with the already recorded full-state digests of the public fixed 252, registered 96 and opened 96, including 02, 12 and 13; stop on a match.
exclusions.limitations: The custom 96 report provides no full-state digest here and is checked by its recorded seed only. A different full-state digest does not prove a different physical state when metadata or representation differ. Other history, other fingerprint formats and sealed-test overlap are unverified. No reservation or unknown-origin fingerprint ledger was read.
